host.cpu: Intel Core i7-6700K, 4 physical / 8 logical cores
host.capture: four Arducam OV9281 UVC cameras, 320x240 MJPEG at requested 100 FPS

scope.native_boundary: Sustained actual desktop capture+tracking+recording after warmup; application CPU from /proc ticks, 100% is one CPU core. Startup, finalization and independent ffprobe excluded.
scope.decode_verification: Each completed video independently decoded in full after app closed; actual video frame count equals complete all-frame numeric and quality rows. Accepted-only rows exactly match accepted decisions.
scope.limits: Live scene differs between runs; this matrix proves processed numeric throughput and file alignment, not physical tracking accuracy or verified sensor-level no-loss acquisition.
scope.target: At least 95 processed FPS per camera for nominal 100 FPS capture; this is not a universal or exact 100 FPS guarantee.

phase_baseline.boundary: Serial saved native PNGs, unchanged frame repeated; PNG read/decode and initial warmup render excluded. Render includes validation, geometry construction, remap, overlays, allocation. Codec write includes RGB conversion, encode, packet drain and AVI write; init/finalization separately timed. No capture, tracking, UI, or concurrency; not sustained camera FPS.

original_live_reference.boundary: Original internal timing; different boundary from sustained Rust native process and phase measurements.

phase_cached.boundary: Serial saved native PNGs, unchanged frame repeated; PNG read/decode and initial warmup render excluded. Direct render includes validation, geometry construction, remap, overlays, allocation. Cached render excludes one-time validated geometry construction but includes dynamic views/overlays, RGB sampling, and allocation. Codec write includes RGB conversion, encode, packet drain and AVI write; init/finalization separately timed. No capture, tracking, UI, or concurrency; not sustained camera FPS.
